rules.typical_range: p25 to p75 of deduped A/B observations, 3xMAD outliers excluded, ends rounded in the display unit
rules.band: in range inside p25-p75; near within 10% outside the nearer end; above/below market beyond that; an ad's own range is banded on its midpoint
rules.experience_level: years of experience required in the ad (low < 5, mid 5 to 9, high 10+), else title seniority words (trainee/junior/assistant -> low; senior/lead/chief/superintendent/supervisor -> high); years win when both exist
rules.level_fallback: a level cell is shown only at 10+ ads; otherwise the role x region cell applies
rules.trend: monthly median where at least 3 months have 5+ observations
